name: Chapter 7 - Attendee Assistant
brief: Attendee-facing API pages for the Business Central MCP server.
description: Chapter 7 app. Publishes the program of an event (Chapter 3 Event Session, with the rooms of Chapter 6), the attendee's reservations (Chapter 6 Session Attendee Res. Entry) and a log of schedule changes as purpose-built API pages that an MCP server configuration turns into tools for the attendee assistant.
